messages.subject: DataTables pop up warning on firefox?
parts:
I uploaded a file and have a option to check/uncheck the columns to display.  Every 2 "uncheck" column variables i get the following error:  

DataTables warning (table id = 'DataTables_Table_7'): Requested unknown parameter '2' from the data source for row 0

Thanks in advance!

messages.author: 8fcb58c8354a7d8f
messages.subject: Re: DataTables pop up warning on firefox?
parts: I also see this error information. It occurs when I uncheck 2 or more column variables very fast. If the data table doesn't have enough time to refresh from a previous uncheck, the error appears in following unchecks. If you click ok to close the error, the data table can still update correctly. Is there any way to avoid showing the error information?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: DataTables pop up warning on firefox?
parts:
Okay, I can reproduce this problem on ShinyApps, but not locally, by
pressing my mouse like crazy to check/uncheck a column repeatedly. I
do not know why this happens or how to fix it. My guess is there is a
substantial delay of data transmission through WebSockets. Hopefully
nobody really clicks the mouse so quickly, but I agree this can be a
real problem when the data is large. I have filed an issue for it:
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/561

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: 45270654016f7b30
messages.subject: Re: DataTables pop up warning on firefox?
parts:
Hi Yihui,

In my case, I don't need to click crazily to replicate such issue. 

Most of the case, such table id does not exist are due to unnecessary reactive behavior setup for the data table. Putting the right trigger component and isolate will solve for normal usage.
BUT, such issue did not happen before I sync the latest dev version from 10.1.
